brief:
The UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs reported that more than 1,500 Palestinians have been displaced from the Jordan Valley since the start of 2026, citing Israeli settler attacks and occupation-imposed restrictions as the cause.

The displacements mark an acceleration of pressure on Palestinian communities in the strategically sensitive area, where Israeli settlements and military control have long restricted Palestinian movement and resource access. The UN agency did not specify the precise timeline of individual displacement incidents or the number of communities affected.
